g.text: One expert: performance as lower-confidence answers are excluded
Same 30 trials reused at each threshold. Confidence is an ordinal 1–7 agreement rating, not a probability.
Intervals assume independent trials and do not quantify variation across experts. No pre-teaching baseline.
